scope: Sanitized decision trail; private logs are identified by SHA-256 but not redistributed

current_head_reproducibility.reason: These three source revisions were superseded before this workspace had version-control history; the known-bad 0.7.0 active path is intentionally not reintroduced

events.finding: 32 MiB host allocation at 0x86c000000 mapped to low bounced device address 0x84dee000; identity=0 and device_above4G=0
events.decision: Do not use the EFI Map result as a direct-high-DMA path; inspect platform state and require separate proof

events.finding: Physical U confirmation succeeded, but the real core stopped in GUARDS before reset/write; intermediate Success was not FRTS success
events.decision: Do not retry; reproduce the exact boundary with read-only per-guard tracing
Replay the physical-confirmation/watchdog boundary rather than treating the earlier snapshot as dispositive

events.finding: SEC2 DMACTL read 32 observed 0x7 instead of 0x1; changed mask 0x6 was documented IMEM/DMEM scrubbing status
events.decision: Test a bounded read-only scrub wait; never mask unrelated changes or write DMACTL

events.finding: Both runs changed from DMACTL 0x7 to exact stable 0x1 after one 1 ms delay; all 10197 real guard reads then passed
events.decision: Integrate the exact bounded wait into a new active FRTS image

events.finding: All seven stages completed and exact WPR2 bounds LO=0x01ffee00 HI=0x01fffc00 were created
events.decision: Prove same-boot OS handoff separately before combining with full unlock

events.finding: Exact GRUB and config were preloaded and Ubuntu reached the expected root in the same boot
events.decision: Permit handoff only after exact completed/quiescent unlock success

events.finding: All pre-mutation integration checks passed, but no U key arrived within 30 seconds; pool released and firmware fallback booted Ubuntu
events.decision: Classify as safe cancellation, not a failed active execution

events.finding: Exact selector/mailbox/stage/quiescence result, same-boot stock-driver handoff, and 1021.9858 FLOP/SM-cycle
events.decision: Obtain a full-power-cycle locked same-board control and an independent second unlock

events.finding: 32.4437 TFLOPS and 511.6813 FLOP/SM-cycle with USB physically absent
events.decision: Compare with the same binary and then repeat the unlock from another full power cycle

events.finding: Independent power-cycle reproduction with identical 1021.9858 FLOP/SM-cycle and no observed Xid/AER error
events.decision: Preserve raw evidence, explicit failures, scope limits, and exact build/test inputs for publication
